reasons: Datadog system.cpu.idle/system/iowait/user/stolen/guest are agent-computed CPU percentages, not a single OTel metric.

The closest OTel metric, system.cpu.time (sum, seconds, per state), measures cumulative CPU time. A percent would need rate() divided by the core count and multiplied by 100, which is derived from other metrics and includes a constant not in the Datadog source.
Blocking with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING is the correct outcome under the hard rules. A proposed expression such as rate(system_cpu_time by state) / cores * 100 could go in notes.
otel_metric_definitions is empty, so the metric definitions and label names could not be checked directly; the verdict relies on the known OTel hostmetrics definition of system.cpu.time.
